responsibility: This definition file enumerates the public target instruction pattern interfaces that machine descriptions may provide directly outside the optab mechanism. Each DEF_TARGET_INSN entry names a backend-visible RTL pattern such as prologue/epilogue, call forms, stack save/restore, traps, cache management, OpenACC/OpenMP SIMT helpers, and other special instructions, along with its operand prototype; repeated inclusion of this file generates target hook fields such as have_*, gen_*, and code_for_* in the target hook infrastructure.
